descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: native-device variant + wrong device clock.

Bug B18 · S1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8); TFA-92597 ready for qa (R6); TFA-92579 AC 3/4 ready for qa (NEW TODAY); TFA-94745 ready for qa (draft restore) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms. TC-16/S18 (UAT 3.8, one device set to the wrong date): a phone a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow on the shared record, and the next write from a correctly clocked device lists the lines before it twice (the transcript archive trusts the device date). Which calendar day a correct device should use when its local day and the server's UTC day differ is the open question Q9 (D10); TC-16/S25 passed otherwise. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579/92584): a browser whose day is ahead writes the badge roll back to the server, and every device shows Follow-up, with the matching template and billing family (TC-01/S08, TC-20/S20a; TFA-92584 AC 8). The failing cell of TC-25/S24a is the card's NEW TODAY, which compares addedAt with the device's date (PatientCard.tsx:154-156). EFS/S28 (a)(b) restore drafts by the device date (TFA-94745); (c), an old draft put in today's box, is B13's. Review 2026-10-15 (TFA-94514): the analytics day is the device date too (pilotUsageEvents / pilotDailyRounding use localDay()): a phone 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day, and an encounter across the phone midnight is split over two days and never timed (OAT-06/S10). Re-test 2026-10-16 (TC-21/S26, 25acd727): a browser two days ahead writes the badge roll with its own future day (encTypeDay 2026-10-19) to the shared record, so the correct-clock browser shows Follow-up too. Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: task done time and Important Points now use server time (TC-22/S23, TC-12/S23, TC-07/S28 stamp); still device time: Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary edit (TC-17/S25), task screen header date (TC-07/S28), handoff title date (TC-08/S20), medicationsUpdatedAt (TC-19/S19), NEW TODAY (TC-01/S08), completeEncounter day (OAT-06/S10).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S18, TC-06/S19, OAT-06/S10, TC-06/S23, TC-21/S22, TC-25/S24b, TC-19/S23, TC-21/S26, TC-07/S28, TC-08/S20

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S25 Native iOS/Android on the local stack: Copy to EMR and Copy A&P paste the latest edit; a phone with its date a day ahead shows the same Post-Round state (3.8)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 After editing the note, 'Copy to EMR' copies the current edited text to the clipboard (a clipboard copy only). (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U5 Editing the note again and re-tapping 'Copy to EMR' copies the latest edited text. (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U6 'Copy Assessment & Plan only' copies just the A&P section to the clipboard. (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T2 Copy is clipboard only: no real EHR read or write happens anywhere. (TFA-92595 AC 3; TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U15 Server time, not device time (3.8): on a device whose clock or time zone is wrong, Post-Round for a completed encounter shows the same note, 'Encounter Complete', tasks and Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summa … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given A phone build pointed at the local stack (Android: the android-lane.ts debug APK with adb reverse 4510/4511), a fresh @roundai.test account, a synthetic note-ready patient, and a completed patient with kept tasks and a saved Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary; a second device with the correct clock

When Edit the note, Save Edits, Copy to EMR, paste into Notes / Keep; edit again, copy, paste; tap Copy A&P (once built), paste. Then set the phone's date one day ahead (and, in a second pass, another time zone), open the completed patient's Post-Round on both devices, edit Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary on the wrong-clock p …

Then Each paste equals the latest saved edit (the A&P paste is just that section); no EHR app or browser opens; the Pending Tasks sheet is fully usable on the phone. On the wrong-clock phone the note, 'Encounter Complete', the tasks and Tomorrow's summary are the same as on the correct-clock device, and the saved nextPreRoundSummaryAt is within 1 min of server t …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester compares the pasted text with the saved note on screen; the Copy A&P part stays blocked until it is built (known: TFA-92595 AC 4). Clock: the same visible state on both devices, and the stored timestamp read with a query against server time. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed (failed (the lane flagged no product issue)).

Detail:

pr-tc17-s25-clock.spec.ts (native half stays manual, device-only). Browser with clock +24 h in Pacific/Kiritimati: same note, completion, tasks and Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary as the right-clock browser, both modes (pass); its stored session was treated as expired and it had to sign in again (B33). Saving an edited Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary there stores nextPreRoundSummaryAt = device time: skew +86400 s vs server, Hospital and NH (FAILED, UAT 3.8 'server time, not device time'; TomorrowPreRoundSummaryCard.tsx:131 and snf PostRoundTab.tsx:102 write new Date() / nowIso()). Same root cause family as B18.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Set aside on dev (Quinn, 2026-10-14): iOS and Android are left out of the dev run, and this needs a native phone build (paste into Notes / Keep, the phone's own clock and time zone).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
